cues: Confusable pairs are learnt by their difference.
Affect is the verb and effect the noun: the rain affected the crop, and the effect was severe.
Advice is the noun with a c, advise the verb with an s, and practice and practise follow the same rule.
The principal is a person or the chief thing; a principle is a rule.
Stationary means not moving; stationery is paper and pens.
Lose a match; a loose knot.
Its, belonging to it; it's, it is.
text: Confusable pairs are learnt by their difference. Affect is the verb and effect the noun: the rain affected the crop, and the effect was severe. Advice is the noun with a c, advise the verb with an s, and practice and practise follow the same rule. The principal is a person or the chief thing; a principle is a rule. Stationary means not moving; stationery is paper and pens. Lose a match; a loose knot. Its, belonging to it; it's, it is. Accept, receive; except, leave out.
